title: We Are Born Good
synopsis: A restaurant mishap led to a feud between Wing-kat and Zoey. Both, whose lives were already challenging, engaged in a cycle of revenge that escalated further.

synopsis_lang.en: A restaurant mishap led to a feud between Wing-kat and Zoey. Both, whose lives were already challenging, engaged in a cycle of revenge that escalated further.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 一宗出錯餐事件，令榮吉（楊偉倫 飾）與若蕾（鍾雪瑩 飾）交惡，冤冤相報、愈演愈烈。生活本已艱辛的二人，彷彿成了壓垮對方的稻草。

cast: Yeung Wai Lun,  Chung Suet Ying, Kearen Pang, Lo Chun Yip,Ng Wing Sze, YAN Yuk Yu Amy
